correctness.rationale: Temporary weighting of all edges by sign of smaller endpoint yields Catalan triangle-splitting recurrence H(i,j)=s_iΣ_kH(i,k)H(k,j), generating series E_L and O_L=−E_L. Formal-series solution gives alternating W_N=0 for even N and C_{(N−3)/2} for odd N. For odd N, any diagonal belongs to C_aC_b triangulations where a+b=N−2 odd; one Catalan factor is even, so W_N(b)≡C_{N−2} mod4 at every frequency. By v2 Catalan=s2(index+1)−1, all coefficients nonzero whenever s2(N−1)≤2. An exact signed triangle recursion at N15 independently yields 132 on alternating set and zero after toggling (0,8),(2,6), with signed containment totals 50,56,20 giving 132−100−112+80=0. All smaller odd N≤13 meet zero-free criterion, so N15 is the first odd singular polygon.
residual_risks: First odd singular does not claim first singular polygon, since even N≥4 singular.
